description: Modular evidence-classification vocabulary. Applied at MODULE and PARAMETER level (not only whole-profile). Replaces the previous binary QUALIFIED/NOT-QUALIFIED logic.

component_labels.DIRECT_EXACT: Same API + carrier/formulation + route/tissue, directly measured in an opened primary.
component_labels.DIRECT_PARTIAL: Same core system, some experimental details differ (or read from a figure not the text).
component_labels.MECHANISTIC_TRANSFER: Parameter/relationship transferred from a related system with explicit rationale.
component_labels.BENCHMARK: Tests a transport mechanism / numerical behaviour; not claimed as the exact therapeutic system.
component_labels.CALIBRATED: Estimated by fitting model output to data.
component_labels.INFERRED: Derived from published quantities/equations, not directly reported.
component_labels.ASSUMED: Required for simulation, unsupported by direct quantitative evidence.
component_labels.ILLUSTRATIVE_COUPLING: Separate modules coupled for education/visualization; not an exact validated end-to-end formulation.
component_labels.EXTERNALLY_VALIDATED: Tested against an independent dataset not used for calibration.
component_labels.UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY: Reported in a secondary source or search summary; primary not opened/verified.

profile_levels.LEVEL_0_ILLUSTRATIVE_ONLY: Mathematical/educational visualization; insufficient quantitative biological support.
profile_levels.LEVEL_1_MECHANISTIC_BENCHMARK: Real data support a transport mechanism, not a complete therapeutic formulation.
profile_levels.LEVEL_3_RESEARCH_SUPPORTED_COMPOSITE: Multiple compatible evidence modules coupled transparently; not validated as one exact end-to-end system.
profile_levels.LEVEL_4_FORMULATION_SPECIFIC_CALIBRATED: Exact formulation has data sufficient for meaningful calibration.
profile_levels.LEVEL_5_EXTERNALLY_VALIDATED_RESEARCH_MO: Independent validation exists for the intended endpoint.
profile_levels.LEVEL_6_CLINICALLY_QUALIFIED: Only if genuinely justified; not expected in this project.

rule: Stage 3 may proceed with LEVEL 1-4 profiles if limitations are explicit and unsupported outputs are disabled/labelled. Block the unsupported CLAIM/OUTPUT, not the whole profile.
